top_findings.title: LLMs for Time Series: an Application for Single Stocks and Statistical Arbitrage
top_findings.summary: LLM-guided factor decomposition for optimal residual extraction in pairs/stat-arb. Valeyre (2019) proved trading factor residuals is mathematically optimal. LLM updates time-varying factor loadings to minimize mean-reversion half-life. Complements Moira (HRL+LLM pair selection, arXiv:2605.01954): Moira selects pairs; Valeyre extracts optimal residual. Staged as proposal 3 (H316 design update).
top_findings.action: Staged as wiki update to pairs-trading.md H316 section

top_findings.title: Dynamic Multi-Pair Trading with DRL in Cryptocurrency Markets
top_findings.summary: DRL as execution overlay on cointegration-based pair signals in crypto. GitHub: damianlebiedz/pair-trading-with-rl. Applies to OOS 2025 crypto data. Less relevant to equity pairs (our H307 family closed due to structural breaks); moderate relevance for crypto extension if H276 NautilusTrader crypto strategy resumes.
top_findings.action: Not staged — crypto focus, H307 ETF pairs family closed

top_findings.title: Enhancing Post Earnings Announcement Drift Measurement with Large Language Models
top_findings.summary: Compares BART, FinBERT, LLaMA 3 on PEAD prediction. FinBERT still generates strongest returns. LLaMA 3 unfinetuned underperforms. Key finding: generic LLMs don't beat FinBERT on PEAD — but none were task-finetuned. Validates H174 architecture choice. Combined with XiaomoWu/PEAD (task-finetuned Mistral), suggests next improvement is finetuning, not model size.
top_findings.action: Staged as H375 proposal (finetuned LLM PEAD)

top_findings.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
top_findings.summary: 138,000 press releases 2005-2023. Structured extraction (guidance, CEO quote, revenue table, summary paragraph) with BERT outperforms flat-document BERT on EA-day and PEAD windows. AUC improvement ~0.04. Direct upgrade path for H174 which treats 8-K as flat document.
top_findings.action: Staged as H372 proposal (structure-aware press release NLP)

top_findings.title: Finetuning LLM to Predict PEAD from Earnings Call Transcripts
top_findings.summary: Finetunes Mistral 7B and LLaMA 3.1 8B on earnings call data using GradPerp algorithm to prevent gradient conflicts. Most concrete implementation for LLM-based PEAD classification. Uses Lightning + Hydra. Transcript-based (vs H174's 8-K document). Complementary: H174 uses press releases, H375 would use transcript.
top_findings.action: Staged as H375 proposal (finetuned LLM PEAD)

top_findings.title: Predicting Stock Price Direction on Earnings Announcement Days using Multi-modal Deep Learning
top_findings.summary: Multi-modal approach (price + text) for EA-day direction. Not staged — our H174 is EA-day + PEAD window, not just EA-day. Architecture is overcomplicated for our use case.

top_findings.title: MAX Factor × Momentum Interaction: +2.5%/month Alpha Pocket
top_findings.summary: High-MAX stocks within high-momentum decile generate +2.5%/month vs +0.9% unconditional momentum. Retail herding amplifies trend in lottery-like momentum stocks. Reverses unconditional MAX underperformance (-0.55%/month). Actionable within H198 universe: tilt selection toward higher-MAX top-momentum stocks.
top_findings.action: Staged as H373 proposal (MAX-momentum tilt on H198)

top_findings.title: A Four-Factor Model Based on Factor Momentum
top_findings.summary: Factor momentum (momentum of FF factors) explains stock, industry, and regional momentum but not vice versa. Four-factor model: market + size + value + factor momentum. Relevant for H318 meta-agent ETF selector (factor momentum = momentum of strategy returns). Not staged — abstract concept, no direct implementation path beyond what we already know.
top_findings.action: Not staged — conceptual input to H318 design

top_findings.title: TS-Agent: Structured Agentic Workflows for Financial Time-Series Modeling
top_findings.summary: Modular agentic LLM framework: planner + model bank + code refinement loop + fine-tuning controller. Beats AutoML and existing agentic systems (ReAct, Reflexion) on financial time series by +12% accuracy, +0.3-0.5 Sharpe. GitHub: yinshuo-thu/TS-Agent. Architecture pattern directly applicable to H274 (multi-agent PEAD) and H318 (meta-agent ETF selector). Not a new hypothesis — design input.
top_findings.action: Staged as wiki update to multi-agent-llm-trading.md

key_meta_findings: FinBERT remains the best-performing model for PEAD on STANDARD benchmarks (ACL FinNLP-2025) — H174 architecture is validated
Task-finetuned LLMs (XiaomoWu/PEAD) represent the credible next improvement over H174, not just larger models
MAX×Momentum interaction paper changes interpretation of H336 (52WH failed) and H337 (quality failed): behavioral signals in large-cap universes require interaction context, not standalone screening
arXiv:2509.24254 press release structure paper is directly actionable on H174's 8-K data without new data sources
TS-Agent (arXiv:2508.13915) provides the missing architecture pattern for H274 multi-agent PEAD: planner + refinement loop
